title: SamaReew: urban expansion in Senegalese cities, 2016–2025
description:
Open-data atlas comparing Senegalese cities (Dakar, Touba, Thiès, Mbour). Built-up areas are mapped every year from Sentinel-2 imagery with Google Earth Engine and one national Random Forest model, cleaned with a temporal consistency filter and checked by an independent accuracy assessment of 480 photo-interpreted points.

This record archives the source code, the method (METHODOLOGIE.md, French) and the indicator tables. The yearly rasters are in samareew-data.zip, attached to each GitHub release.

Website: https://bigtapha.github.io/samareew/
